empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

card.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be unlinked from every agent. This cannot be undone.
card.disableConfirm: Disable "{name}"? A disabled skill never reaches a prompt, so it will be detached from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}. Re-enabling does not restore those links.
card.disabledToast: "{name}" disabled and detached from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface. Write it directively — when should an agent apply this? It is the first thing the agent reads.
config.bodyHint: A skill is text only. It runs no code and has no access to tools or files.
config.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

Describe when the agent should apply this…
config.noteHint: Shown in the version history. Saving a changed body creates a new version.
config.notePlaceholder: Tightened scope rule; cap at 5 high-signal findings

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

stats.scopeNote: Counted across runs where this skill was in the prompt. A single finding is not attributed to a single skill — one run concatenates every linked skill into one prompt.
stats.noAgents: No agent links this skill yet.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.body: Attach this skill to an agent and run a review — these numbers fill in from real runs.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body from v{version}? This creates a new version — history is never rewritten.
versions.diffTitle: v{version} compared with the current body
versions.identical: This version is identical to the current body.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a Markdown file or a .zip archive
import.dropzone: Drop a .md or .zip here, or click to choose
import.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {# file skipped, not stored} other {# files skipped, not stored}}

skipReason.unused_markdown: markdown, but another file was used

import.trustWarning: Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read the body before you enable it — imported skills are created disabled.
import.saved: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you enable it.
